fato_historico: 2025: A magnitude 8.8 earthquake hits Russia, causing tsunamis over the Pacific Ocean.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos hums with a powerful vibration today, reminding us that even when the earth shifts beneath our feet and giant waves stir the ocean, our inner core remains unshakable. It is a good time to ground yourself in your own truth. You may find that flexibility becomes your greatest strength as you navigate life's sudden, transformative movements.
frase_do_dia: Find your inner calm even when the world around you seems to shift.
significado_numero: Represents the infinite flow of energy and strength in difficult times.
conselho: Consider embracing change with a hopeful heart and steady, grounded actions today.
